sources.title: Jubilee Bus Station forecourt and opposite motorcycle parking
sources.notes: The provider shows October2021, an older capture that must not be treated as current2026 verification. The forecourt view shows a long roughly three-level cream terminal block with broad dark-blue horizontal bands, rectangular room windows, flat overhanging roofline and bus stands. Blue/white city and red/white regional buses are visible. A wheeled traffic-police barrier is in the foreground. The opposite heading20 view shows many parked motorcycles under mature shade trees, a low white/blue compound wall with wire fencing, a small white/blue building, steps and a gate, and red plastic barricades. Geometry, dates of later modifications and current bus liveries are unresolved.
